99: One day at work, unsuccessful puppeteer Craig finds a portal into the head of actor John Malkovich. The portal soon becomes a passion for anybody who enters its mad and controlling world of overtaking another human body.
Ever wanted to be someone else? Now you can.
355: As the west rapidly becomes civilized, a pair of outlaws in 1890s Wyoming find themselves pursued by a posse and decide to flee to South America in hopes of evading the law.
Not that it matters, but most of it is true.
611: The Dwarves, Bilbo and Gandalf have successfully escaped the Misty Mountains, and Bilbo has gained the One Ring. They all continue their journey to get their gold back from the Dragon, Smaug.
Beyond darkness... beyond desolation... lies the greatest danger of all.
867: Meet Joel Goodson, an industrious, college-bound 17-year-old and a responsible, trustworthy son. However, when his parents go away and leave him home alone in the wealthy Chicago suburbs with the Porsche at his disposal he quickly decides he has been good for too long and it is time to enjoy himself. After an unfortunate incident with the Porsche Joel must raise some cash, in a risky way.
There's a time for playing it safe and a time for Risky Business.
1123: An alien and a robot land on Earth after World War II and tell mankind to be peaceful or face destruction.
From out of space...A warning and an ultimatum.
1379: Primo and Secondo, two immigrant brothers, pin their hopes on a banquet honoring Louis Prima to save their struggling restaurant.
In love and life, one big night can change everything.
1635: Cecilia is a waitress in New Jersey, living a dreary life during the Great Depression. Her only escape from her mundane reality is the movie theatre. After losing her job, Cecilia goes to see 'The Purple Rose of Cairo' in hopes of raising her spirits, where she watches dashing archaeologist Tom Baxter time and again.
She's finally met the man of her dreams. He's not real, but you can't have everything.
1891: 9-year-old Alex Pruitt is home alone with the chicken pox. Turns out, due to a mix-up among nefarious spies, Alex was given a toy car concealing a top-secret microchip. Now Alex must fend off the spies as they try to break into his house to get it back.
There's a new kid on the block.
2403: After a carnival troupe saves his life, a man agrees to help its immortal leader collect five souls and win a bet with the devil.
The man who tried to cheat the devil.
2659: Jack Manfred is an aspiring writer who to make ends meet, takes a job as a croupier. Jack remains an observer, knowing that everything in life is a gamble and that gamblers are born to lose. Inevitably, he gets sucked into the world of the casino which takes its toll on his relationships and the novel he is writing.
2915: In 1976, a teenage girl struggles to cope while living with her neurotic lower-middle-class family of nomads on the outskirts of Beverly Hills.
Growing up is hard to do.
3171: When the owner of the Minnesota Twins passes away, he bequeaths the team to his preteen grandson. The newly minted head honcho quickly appoints himself manager, causing unrest in an organization that struggles to take orders from a 12-year-old.
The Minnesota Twins Have A New Owner
3427: A Mississippi district attorney and the widow of Medgar Evers struggle to bring a white supremacist to justice for the 1963 murder of the civil rights leader.
A forgotten crime. An impossible case. A final chance... for justice.
3683: A band of soldiers is dispatched to war games deep in the woods. When they stumble across a rival team slaughtered in camp, they realize they're not alone.
Six men. Full moon. No chance.
3939: A conniving Broadway producer and his meek accountant plan to profit from charming wealthy old biddies to invest in an overbudget production, and then put on a sure-fire disaster, so nobody will ask for their money back — and what's more disastrous than a tasteless musical celebrating Adolf Hitler.
They had everything to gain by not being a success!
4195: Theseus is a mortal man chosen by Zeus to lead the fight against the ruthless King Hyperion, who is on a rampage across Greece to obtain a weapon that can destroy humanity.
4451: In post-9/11 New York City, an eclectic group of citizens find their lives entangled, personally, romantically, and sexually, at Shortbus, an underground Brooklyn salon infamous for its blend of art, music, politics, and carnality.
Open your mind. And everything else.
4707: After teenage ambulance driver Ernest Hemingway takes shrapnel in the leg during World War I, he falls in love with Agnes von Kurowsky, a beautiful older nurse at the hospital where he's sent to recover. Their affair slowly blossoms, until Hemingway boldly asks Agnes to be his wife and journey to America with him.
In war they found each other...In each other they found love...
4963: Cinephile slackers Franz and Arthur spend their days mimicking the antiheroes of Hollywood noirs and Westerns while pursuing the lovely Odile. A Who-Dunit, Who's Got-It, Where-Is-It-Now Wild One From That "Breathless" director Jean-Luc Godard!
5219: Jesse moves into an old family property where his parents were mysteriously murdered years before. He soon finds himself with unexpected guests in the form of his mummified great-great grandfather, a mystical crystal skull, and a zombie cowboy.

Jackie Chan in his greatest adventure ever!
5731: In the late 1970s, Cockney crime boss Harold Shand, a gangster trying to become a legitimate property mogul, has big plans to get the American Mafia to bankroll his transformation of a derelict area of London into the possible venue for a future Olympic Games. Who lit the fuse that tore Harold's world apart?
5987: Forced out of their apartment due to dangerous works on a neighboring building, Emad and Rana move into a new flat in the center of Tehran. An incident linked to the previous tenant will dramatically change the young couple’s life.
6243: Middle-aged suburban husband Richard abruptly tells his wife, Maria, that he wants a divorce. 6499: For years, old wood carver Mr. Meacham has delighted local children with his tales of the fierce dragon that resides deep in the woods of the Pacific Northwest. Some secrets are too big to keep.
6755: In 1940s New York, a white widow who dreams of being on Broadway has a chance encounter with a black single mother, who becomes her maid.
Fannie Hurst's best selling novel of today's tormented generation!
7011: Young Bart Collins lives with his widowed mother Heloise. While grimly hammering away at his lessons, Bart dozes off and enters a fantastical musical dream.
The Wonder Musical of the Future!
7523: Jessie is an aging career criminal who has been in more jails, fights, schemes, and lineups than just about anyone else. There's nothing like a good robbery to bring a family together.
7779: Suffering from a kidney disease and sure of his death, Uncle Boonmee assembles his relatives in the countryside. He reminisces about his past lives and plans to visit a place before dying.

Is there a formula for love?
8291: A white teacher takes over a talented, but undisciplined Black high school basketball team and turns them into winners.
8547: In late 19th century France, the Countess Louise, wife of a wealthy general, sells the earrings her husband gave her on their wedding day to pay off her secret debts, then claims to have lost them. It was her vanity that destroyed her.

Sometimes there’s nothing left to do but laugh!

He loved her like there was no tomorrow.
9315: Enigmatic gangster Silien may or may not be responsible for informing on Faugel,  who was just released from prison and is already involved in what should be a simple heist. By the end of this brutal, twisting, and multilayered policier, who will be left to trust?
9571: Batman, along with many of his allies and adversaries, finds himself transported to feudal Japan by Gorilla Grodd's time displacement machine.
10083: A friendship with a top-secret robot turns a lonely girl's life into a thrilling adventure as they take on bullies, evil bots and a scheming madman.

They went up like men! They came down like animals!

With friends like these, who needs family?

His path is paved in blood.

Mr. de Blénac, editor-in-chief of the newspaper
Georges Pouzier, owner of the toy store

13667: To inherit her father's company, socialite Ellen must first visit his small hometown, where she learns the value of hard work and helping others.

Like we've taken the Robin Hood legend and changed the bows and arrows to machine guns...! Like with songs yet!.. Like WILD!

14947: A commitment-averse man frantically hits the dating scene after his girlfriend starts pressuring him to pop the question.
Why buy the cow, when you can get the milk for free?

The less you know, the safer you are.

16483: A Russian criminal steals a giant diamond from the Mafia, hides it, and suddenly runs into his unknown brothers; unexpected, absurd events with participation of the mob, doctors, musicians, Americans, militia, and gypsies ensue.
Vasiliy Krolikov / Innokentiy Shniperson / Roman Almazov / Patrick Crolikow
Carol Abzats / Zemfira Almazova / Lusiena Krolikova / Whitney Crolikow
16739: Faithful wife Melinda, who is tired of standing by her devious husband Robert, is enraged when it becomes clear she has been betrayed. That's when she lost it, and now she cannot let it go.
17251: A newly wed couple, Tacy and Nicky, travel in a trailer for their honeymoon. The journey is a humorous one that could end up destroying their marriage.
America's No. 1 Favorites—Funnier than Ever on the Screen!
17763: Charlotte Gainsbourg agrees to play a witch condemned to be burned at the stake in the first film directed by Béatrice Dalle. But the chaotic production, technical problems, and psychotic breakdowns gradually plunge the shoot into a chaos of pure light.

Warner Bros. thunderous story of the men of the merchant marine!
19043: The crew of the merchant ship Glencairn hope to survive a transatlantic crossing during World War II. Adapted from four Eugene O'Neill one-act plays.
The Love of Women in Their Eyes... The Salt of the Sea in Their Blood!
19555: "Michael Moore doesn't like documentaries. That's why he doesn't make them." A documentary that looks to distinguish what's fact, fiction, legend, and otherwise as a camera crew trails Michael Moore as he tours with his film, Fahrenheit 9/11.

20323: A former high school student who always wanted to be a cheerleader decides to reopen the cheerleading program at her former high school after years of closure for being targeted by a serial killer.
Finally, a movie that is totally taste-free.
20835: Three teenage brothers are terrorized by a trio of escaped mental patients disguised as clowns.
21347: A common man kidnaps the son of the Home Minister of India to get answers about the loss of his own son, caused by the illegal acts committed by corrupt government officials.

Marco Muha, a friend of Kondrat Perepelitsa, postman
Grishka, a friend of Maksim Perepelitsa

In the 70s, during the last stages of Franco's dictatorship, Txema, a basque construction worker, is arrested because of his connection to some terrorists who have just committed a murder. The secret service see in him an ideal candidate to infiltrate the terrorist band ETA and become a mole, so they try to offer him a deal if he will do so.

23651: Kabir and his family's fun weekend retreat takes terrifying turn when an intruder takes over the control of the  body of his teenage daughter, putting her at the mercy of his increasingly sinister orders.
23907: A middle-class boy in Ahmedabad, Satyaprem falling in one-sided love with Katha, who is coping with her breakup with Tapan. Through the journey, they discover each other's life and complement in accomplishing what was left halfway.
24163: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.
"I was — to be frank — a spoiled, miserable, narcissistic, self-destructive and thoughtless young lout, and badly in need of a good ass-kicking."
24419: Raghu, a simpleton, and his best friend decide to run a food stall to get rid of their unemployment. However, Raghu's life takes a drastic turn after he accidentally kills one of their customers and he is pushed into a life of crime.

25187: A prosperous young Indian man falls in love with his servant, a widow with the dream of becoming a fashion designer.
25443: When a fostered teenage rebel suspects that her father is not dead but in fact kidnapped by UFOs, she takes help from a UFO association to discover the truth. Power was the plan. Putin was the consequence.

26211: A disavowed Indian commando helps protect a woman from a local thug who is hellbent on forcing her to marry him.

Uncover the corruption. Discover the truth.

Some trials don't end in court.

Takes you beyond the land of the Black Sand!
Bartender / Guitar Player at Puerto Miguel (uncredited)

Nothing Could Stop the Last Wagon From Coming Through!

A woman trying to live her own life-A man who wouldn't let her-A wife living without love, fighting them both with the bitter weapons of a desperate heart!

An ancient evil. Trapped in a world of darkness. Waiting for someone to believe.

In classroom, he meets the gorgeous nineteen years old student Vanina Abati, who is Gerardo's girlfriend.
29539: In an effort to land the guy she's been pining after since grade school, Abby hires a local stripper named Santa Monica to teach her everything she needs to know about confidence and sex.
To get the guy, she'll need the right teacher.

Some messes can't be cleaned up.

There's only one way to end bad blood

The movie takes us through the fun filled happenings that awaits Prasoon in his workplace.

Roya migrates to the united states with her family due to some social restrictions of 1980s. Arjang who has never forgotten Roya, meets her different times later but each time he fails to marry her again. He has 50 now and is a wealthy man, so he insists Roya to stay in Iran and marry him.

Nobody's as good as Bette when she's bad!

You can't soar until someone lifts you up.
33635: A group of greedy people were entering enchanted Forest in search of treasure and unexpectedly they over come hurdles in a mysterious way. did they find the solution and did escape from the hurdles in the forest

A square from Nebraska? An off-beatnik from Greenwich Village?  It just didn't figure ... that they would ... that they could ... that they did!

Steel Your Nerves! Here's excitement that will smash them!
